claims.claim_ar: «مَنْ» في موضع نصب (أي تُعامل هنا كاسم موصول منصوب).
claims.claim_en: The relative particle 'mān' is in an accusative position (treated as mansub / a relative noun in the accusative).
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted passage in al-Tibyan cites the construction in a different verse (أَعْلَمُ مَنْ جَاءَ). Applicability of that general statement to this particular occurrence in S6:25 should be confirmed.
